Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description (from assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (from target_dictionary.organism). Join molecule_dictionary -> compound_records on molregno -> docs on record_id -> activities on record_id -> assays on assay_id -> target_dictionary on tid. Inner join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1871', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.standard_units = 'nM', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
